tooltips.identifier: Ahpra numbers are PHA and 10 digits. NSW checks look like WWC1234567E, or APP and digits while the application is in progress.
tooltips.issueDate: For police checks, CPR certificates and the immuniser annual review, the expiry is worked out from this date.
tooltips.expiryDate: The credential counts as current through this date. Use the date shown on the register or certificate.
tooltips.status: Only verified credentials count. Changing a checked detail returns this to Pending until someone verifies it again.
tooltips.workRightsBasis: A time-limited visa must have an expiry date. Record work limits under Register conditions.
tooltips.registerStatus: What OCG showed when checked. Only a cleared paid check can be verified here.
tooltips.coverAmount: The standard requires at least $20 million. Record scope and location limits under Register conditions.
tooltips.verifyingEntity: The organisation that made the check, when it wasn't this agency.
tooltips.conditions: Conditions, undertakings or notations on the register. These warn; they don't block.

messages.rxVerificationNeedsMethod: Record how this credential was verified before marking it verified.
messages.rxVerificationNeedsExpiry: This credential type expires. Enter its expiry date before marking it verified.
messages.rxRightToWorkNeedsBasis: State the basis for working in Australia. A time-limited visa also needs its expiry date.
messages.rxChildCheckIncomplete: Only a cleared paid check can be verified. Record the status, check type and date of birth.
messages.rxInsuranceBelowMinimum: Record cover of at least $20 million before marking this verified.
messages.rxRetentionHold: This person's {type} record has to be kept for {years} years after their last work, so it can't be deleted, moved or changed to another type yet.
messages.rxVerificationNeedsIssueDate: Enter an issue date that has passed before marking this credential verified.
